items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: So Mr. Rivers, who was a tall man -- over 6 ft. tall -- he looked down at me and said, "Boy, who told you you could play the drums? Why don't you go home to your mother?"

ctx.x: So I went to Bill Rivers, and I asked him -- no, I didn't ask him, I had said to him, I said, "Look, Mr. Rivers, I heard that you were looking for a drummer. I would appreciate it if you would give me the opportunity to play in your band. I tell you what -- you don't have to pay me any salary for 2 weeks; just take care of my expenses, and if I prove myself all right, then you can put me on salary."

So Mr. Rivers, who was a tall man -- over 6 ft. tall -- he looked down at me and said, "Boy, who told you you could play the drums? Why don't you go home to your mother?" I cried all the way from Second Avenue and 9th Street to Fourth Avenue and 19th Street, I was in tears; I just couldn't believe that you know, I was willing to go in this band and work for nothing --
